text:
Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival - Scarlet Church Trailer
The human experience is counterfeit. 
Only pain and pleasure reveal the nature of their world.
You must bargain with the Scarlet Church, for they can smell the Labyrinth on you...

In the brand-new Steam demo for Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival, players can dive into the mysterious hellscape of the Labyrinth and face off against the wicked Scarlet Church, which has taken the coveted Genesis Configuration into its possession. You'll be introduced to the main characters of the story and their twisted machinations while traversing an ever-shifting realm of nightmares. Discover the basics of combat, crafting and puzzling solving while preparing your body for the complete experience at launch!

Among the many wicked dangers in this brand-new story in the iconic horror franchise, including Pinhead himself (voiced by the legendary Doug Bradley), you'll have to overcome Marlowe and his sacred (or sacrilegious?) Scarlet Church. Backed by an army of unholy priests, deviants, and cultists, Marlowe seeks the Genesis Configuration puzzle box for his own devious ends. With every slice and every drop of blood, the Scarlet Church recruits those bold enough – or foolish enough – to covet Hell’s blasphemous temptations and gifts.
